title: Arbitrary coproducts of quasi-coherent modules are quasi-coherent
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $I$ a small set, and $(M_i)_{i\in I}$ a family of quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. The categorical coproduct $\bigoplus_{i\in I}M_i$ in $\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] is quasi-coherent.

source.place: Schemes, Lemma 01ID; Section 01LA, items (3)-(5). Local source read at /home/ubuntu/c1-stacks-review/schemes.tex, lines 1435-1455 and 4717-4744.

proof.text: Restrict to an affine cover. Each stage restriction is a tilde module by the affine counit isomorphism. Restriction and tilde preserve coproducts, so the coproduct restricts to the tilde of the coproduct of section modules. It therefore has a presentation on each affine open, proving quasi-coherence.
